purpose: Run and independently audit the actual private GPU smooth-k manufactured component, preserving all original Darcy component budgets. This driver never compiles or launches an actual coupled Run/ComputeStep, a physical solver, an old worker, GenCase, a subsequent stage or Git.

inputs.source_and_runtime: Before and after actual calls/review, rehash current frozen source closure, authoritative objects/tools, helper author/include closure, libraries, runtime original/copy pairs, canonical GPU identities and selected immutable input.

actions.Debug: Exactly one compute-sanitizer memcheck invocation with --leak-check full --error-exitcode99; verify actual ERROR SUMMARY0 and LEAK SUMMARY0bytes/0allocations. The retained original Debug component receipt supplies only the immutable tool identity, not a current pass.
actions.Release: One direct selected helper invocation, only after the new Debug check and its owned call/completion/files pass and rehash.
actions.Review: No executable/reader invocation. Read only the selected completed run/call/raw component CSVs and produce the final check.
actions.failure_handling: Seal actual call and run before checking the program result, then preserve partial files and a failed check on program/memcheck failure. Completed-component analysis failure seals a failed offline check and may only be repaired under a fresh offline label, never by rerunning the completed program. Existing output/log/call/run/check paths are protected.
actions.readonly_or_compile_author_actions: PowerShell AST parser and JSON syntax only; no execution by this author.

original_suite.NaN_scope: The sole intentional nonfinite old request is current_nan/current, an explicitly required rejected input. Missing/nonfinite references, actual rates, budgets or other numeric diagnostics are rejected; no default0 substitution.
original_suite.old_file_comparison: Record exact matching-configuration SHA/byte equality for the old completion plus nine CSVs, but do not predeclare equality as an admission gate: independent host reference/compiler last-bit differences can change text without changing the accepted original numerical gate.
original_suite.native_regressions: This descriptive component-text comparison does not relax the separate full actual native OFF/observer/Feedback0ULP gates required by the legacy trajectory driver.
